16.t: Working with data: how unsaturated are fats?
q: Which oil decolourised the most drops?
Calculate how many times more drops sunflower oil took than butter.
Explain what the results show about saturated and unsaturated fats.
Sunflower oil has many C=C double bonds (polyunsaturated); coconut oil and butter are mostly saturated, with few C=C bonds.
The error bars for olive and peanut oil overlap. What can you conclude about these two?
We cannot be sure they are different: the difference could be due to chance. More repeats would be needed.
